Replaced by a structural check (the draw is slot_index(g, n), whose only inputs are the fixed-seed generator and the history length) in C0, and a functional check in C1 (fork's drawn indices equal the content-free sequence slot_index(rng(world,'slot'), n) over the history lengths). The draw itself, the arms, rules, worlds and doses are unchanged.
